name: agents-handoff-monorepo
description: Agents Handoff - a handoff protocol for software changes, built for developers and their coding agents.

scripts.clean: tsc -b --clean packages/core packages/cli && rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/integrations/*/dist
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test packages/core/dist/test/*.test.js packages/mcp/dist/test/*.test.js packages/cli/dist/test/*.test.js
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run test:only && node packages/integrations/claude-code/scripts/write-skills.mjs --check && for f in examples/*/HANDOFF.md; do node packages/cli/dist/src/bin.js validate "$f" --strict || exit 1; done && npm pack --dry-run --workspaces > /dev/null
